resources.string: Align subtitles with dialogue when Auto Sync cannot find a reliable match (ExoPlayer only). For speech recognition to work well with English audio, we recommend add-ons that provide plenty of English subtitles for the title, even when watching subtitles in another language.
Optional, for faster and more precise sync with English audio. Downloads once on an unmetered connection when needed. Audio stays on your device.
Ready. Select to delete the downloaded model.
Download failed. Select to retry. Speech detection still works.
Listens during playback only. No extra data is used, but sync can take longer.
Reads a few short dialogue samples ahead of playback over one connection, up to 75 MB per title. Used on metered networks even when set to High.
Reads more dialogue samples over several connections for the fastest sync, usually up to 150 MB per title and up to 400 MB for very high-bitrate files.

Speech detection uses Silero VAD v5 weights (MIT, Silero Team). Optional speech recognition uses sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0, k2-fsa) and its Zipformer GigaSpeech English model (Apache-2.0). Full notices ship with the app in licenses/audio_sync_NOTICE.md.
